title: Teriyaki haddock with broccoli
summary: Teriyaki haddock with broccoli is a japanese dinner built around haddock fillets and broccoli, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat haddock fillets dry and season it. Prep broccoli and tamari for Teriyaki haddock with broccoli so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook haddock fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook broccoli and tamari in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Teriyaki haddock with broccoli before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice haddock fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
